name: @devchecks/accesscheck
description: Accessibility checks powered by axe-core: scan pages in the browser or local dev URLs with Playwright, with selectors, suggested fixes and baselines.

name: @devchecks/apicontractcheck
description: Check APIs against their OpenAPI contract: validate real responses (live, HAR files or a fetch wrapper) and detect breaking changes between spec versions.

name: @devchecks/archcheck
description: Enforce architecture in JS/TS, React, Vue and Node projects: circular imports, layer rules, restricted modules and module boundaries.

name: @devchecks/configcheck
description: Validate configuration: .env drift against .env.example, required and typed variables, JSON/YAML syntax, and risky settings such as debug mode, CORS wildcards and disabled TLS verification.

name: @devchecks/depcheck
description: Check npm, Yarn and pnpm lockfiles or installed trees against the OSV vulnerability database, with fixed-version guidance and severity thresholds.

name: @devchecks/licensecheck
description: Dependency license inventory and policy checks with SPDX expressions: deny/allow lists, copyleft and unknown licenses, and third-party attribution files.

name: @devchecks/pci-pagecheck
description: PCI DSS readiness aid for payment pages: script inventory against an approved baseline, CSP review, card-data exposure checks and control-mapped evidence.

name: @devchecks/perfcheck
description: Performance budgets: Core Web Vitals and resource weight in the browser, bundle size budgets (gzip/brotli) and Playwright lab runs in CI.

name: @devchecks/safecodecheck
description: AST-based detection of unsafe DOM insertion, dynamic code execution, insecure randomness and risky URL handling, with remediation guidance.

name: @devchecks/secretcheck
description: Detect credentials and high-entropy secrets in staged Git content before they are committed. Secrets are never printed in full.
